commands.label: Glass World
commands.desc: Transparent glass structures create a premium spatial world.
commands.instruction: Use clear, frosted or tinted glass with realistic refraction, caustics and reflections as the supporting environment. Keep supplied product materials unchanged.

commands.label: Chrome / Metal World
commands.desc: Reflective metallic forms create a sculptural commercial environment.
commands.instruction: Use chrome, brushed metal or polished forms as supporting spatial language with controlled reflections. Do not metallize the product unless requested.

commands.label: Fabric Sculpture World
commands.desc: Cloth folds and ribbons become the main spatial device.
commands.instruction: Build a cloth/fabric environment with believable folds, tension, weight and material response around the exact product while keeping labels readable.

commands.label: Paper / Folded World
commands.desc: Folded paper and cards create depth and structure.
commands.instruction: Create a paper-engineered world using folds, cut paper, sheets or origami-like forms with believable thickness and shadows.

commands.label: Clay / Foam World
commands.desc: Soft sculpted tactile forms create playful premium depth.
commands.instruction: Use clay, foam or soft sculpted supporting forms with believable softness, dents and seams while keeping the real product exact.

commands.label: Liquid Interaction
commands.desc: Fluid becomes a storytelling device rather than a generic splash.
commands.instruction: Use pours, ribbons, arcs, waves or suspended droplets with believable viscosity, contact and lighting. Never imply unsupported ingredients.

commands.label: Giant Pour / Wave
commands.desc: Large fluid flow becomes the central spatial idea.
commands.instruction: Create a dramatic but coherent giant pour, wave or flow interacting with architecture, landscape or product. Match category and fluid behavior.

commands.label: Ice / Frozen World
commands.desc: Realistic ice, frost and condensation create a cold campaign world.
commands.instruction: Use ice blocks, frost, bubbles, snow or controlled melt around the exact product. Never imply temperature resistance unless supplied.

commands.label: Fire / Heat
commands.desc: Controlled flame, embers or heat form a cinematic mechanism.
commands.instruction: Use believable flame, ember, glow and heat interaction without damaging the product unless explicitly requested. Never imply heat resistance.

commands.label: Smoke / Cloud Sculpture
commands.desc: Smoke, vapor or cloud forms create sculptural atmosphere.
commands.instruction: Use controlled smoke, mist, vapor or clouds as a spatial device with believable light scattering and product readability.

commands.label: Particle / Swarm
commands.desc: Particles or repeated elements create directional depth.
commands.instruction: Use a structured particle field with purposeful direction, density, scale and depth instead of generic dust.

commands.label: Soft-Body / Inflatable
commands.desc: Puffy forms create playful dimensional impact.
commands.instruction: Use soft-body/inflatable supporting forms with believable seams, pressure, deformation and contact. Preserve real product geometry.

commands.label: Bubble / Transparent Orb
commands.desc: Transparent bubbles and membranes frame the product.
commands.instruction: Use bubbles, membranes or transparent orbs with realistic refraction, surface tension and reflections while keeping the product undistorted.

commands.label: Hologram / Emissive
commands.desc: Controlled luminous forms create a digital spatial world.
commands.instruction: Use holographic or emissive elements only when brand-appropriate, with believable glow, spill light and reflections. Avoid default cyberpunk styling.

commands.label: Mirror / Reflection World
commands.desc: Reflective planes multiply depth in a controlled environment.
commands.instruction: Build a deliberate mirrored environment using accurate reflections, symmetry/asymmetry and depth while keeping branding readable.

commands.label: Organic Growth
commands.desc: Moss, roots, vines or flowers partially reclaim the scene.
commands.instruction: Use organic growth as a controlled takeover of supporting surfaces or architecture. Keep product clean/readable unless coverage is explicitly requested.

commands.label: Sand / Wind Simulation
commands.desc: Wind-driven sand or dust shapes the environment.
commands.instruction: Use believable sand drift, dunes, suspended grains and wind direction around the exact product while preserving label visibility.

commands.label: Crystal / Gem World
commands.desc: Faceted transparent or mineral forms create premium depth.
commands.instruction: Use crystal, gemstone or mineral-inspired supporting forms with believable refraction, roughness and internal light behavior. Do not imply ingredients or composition.

commands.label: Gel / Gummy World
commands.desc: Soft translucent gel forms create playful tactile depth.
commands.instruction: Use jelly, gel or gummy-like supporting forms with believable translucency, deformation and contact. Keep the exact product unchanged.

commands.label: Liquid Metal
commands.desc: Reflective liquid-metal forms flow around product as sculpture.
commands.instruction: Use mercury-like or liquid-metal supporting forms with controlled reflections, surface tension and flow. Do not change product material unless requested.
